sections.title: Total population in West Suffolk
sections.content: In 2024, West Suffolk was the 10th largest local authority in the East of England, with a population of almost 190,000. Since 2001, its population has increased by 22.0%.

sections.title: Population density in West Suffolk
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in West Suffolk was 182 people per square kilometre, which was less than the East of England (344), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Median age in West Suffolk
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in West Suffolk was 41 years, which was the same as the East of England (41 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
